http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#com:
Audit note in plain text describing how this administrative entity was matched against Wikidata: method (exact / fuzzy / override / transitive P131+), normalisation steps applied, search label and matched label, and the confidence score. Carried over verbatim from the matchReason field produced by wikidata_map.py during CSV enrichment.

Multiple rdfs:domain triples are used (Land, Bundesland, Kreis, Gemeinde) rather than owl:unionOf, to keep auto-generated SHACL shapes simple — the auto-generator picks the first domain. The semantic restriction is: the property applies to any of the four administrative-area classes.
